name: Seared Salmon with Parmesan Crusted Potatoes & Cabbage-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Coat two baking dishes with a thin layer of oil, then sprinkle Parmesan and Italian seasoning over the bottom each dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tbsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve potatoes. Arrange in the baking dishes, cut-side down, and press down firmly into the cheese. Drizzle with additional oil and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, undisturbed, until potatoes are tender and Parmesan is browned and crispy, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the potatoes have about 15 minutes left, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season the top side of the salmon with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and medium dice cucumbers. Place in a large bowl along with shredded cabbage and dressing, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
½ cup Italian salad dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salmon, potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
